mapper.select: SELECT CASE ur.role_type WHEN 'admin' THEN '管理员' WHEN 'service' THEN '客服' WHEN 'engineer' THEN '售后技师' WHEN 'finance' THEN '财务' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_user ur WHERE ur.role_type = #{roleTypeStr} GROUP BY ur.role_type

SELECT CASE v.vehicle_type WHEN 0 THEN '轿车' WHEN 1 THEN 'SUV' WHEN 2 THEN '面包车' WHEN 3 THEN '其他' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM vehicle v WHERE v.vehicle_type = #{vehicleType} GROUP BY v.vehicle_type

SELECT CASE ro.status WHEN 0 THEN '待派单' WHEN 1 THEN '作业中' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM repair_order ro AND ro.create_time >= #{startTime} AND ro.create_time <= #{endTime} WHERE ro.status = #{status} GROUP BY ro.status

SELECT CASE po.status WHEN 0 THEN '待审核' WHEN 1 THEN '审核通过' WHEN 2 THEN '已入库' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM purchase_order po AND po.create_time >= #{startTime} AND po.create_time <= #{endTime} WHERE po.status = #{status} GROUP BY po.status
SELECT pc.category_name AS name, SUM(p.stock) AS value FROM part p LEFT JOIN part_category pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} GROUP BY p.category_id, pc.category_name

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(fo.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN fo.order_type = 1 THEN fo.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN fo.order_type = 0 THEN fo.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM finance_order fo WHERE (fo.status IS NULL OR fo.status = 1) AND fo.create_time >= #{startTime} AND fo.create_time <= #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(fo.create_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 12 ) t ORDER BY month ASC
